clips.title: The story
paras: In Sen'jin Village, Master Vornal brews for the Darkspear trolls and keeps his craft to himself. The elderly jungle troll refuses to take on apprentices despite his deep knowledge of alchemy.

Master Vornal brews draughts and spirits for his fellow Darkspear trolls in Sen'jin Village. Age is catching up with him, but he remains fiercely independent and refuses to train an apprentice. He mixes his remedies and volatile brews by his own hand.

Master Vornal sometimes sends young adventurers to gather harsh or unusual ingredients from the surrounding lands. The materials go into solvents and other mixtures. He rewards those who help, but guards his methods and recipes, keeping the work of brewing to himself.
